sections.content: Files let programs persist data beyond a single run — save settings, read datasets, write reports.
The golden rule: use a "with/open" pattern that guarantees the file closes, even if an error occurs. Forgetting close() causes corrupted files and locked resources.
Key points: common modes are read/write/append, always specify encoding for text, and check that files exist before reading.
